description: Somali Air Force fighter mounted on a plinth above a fresco as the centrepiece of the memorial to the 1988 aerial bombardment of Hargeisa. Local and Wikipedia accounts say the airframe crashed nearby and was recovered to the square. No serial has ever been published and none is visible in photographs so tail_number is left blank. The memorial was rebuilt in 2020. aviationmuseum.eu calls this a MiG-15 but every Somaliland source and Wikipedia call it a MiG-17 and the airframe shows MiG-17 planform.
